E0927

`#Bench` is a retired claim spelling

What

`#Bench` is a retired claim spelling

Why

Measurement is a mode of `#Test`, so Jet has one claim family

Fix

Write `#Test("name") { .measure { … } }` and run `jet test --measure`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0927: tests/ui/E0927_allow_marker_legal.stderr.

    |
 10 | #Bogus

 Why: `Bogus` isn't registered as an applied rule — Jet rules are a closed, registered vocabulary (I7), not any PascalCase word.
 Fix: check the spelling, or see docs/spec/syntax-decisions.md for the full applied-rule list.
